本机请求不读取浏览器代理。出口 IP 来自 Cloudflare，仅反映本工具的: Local requests do not read browser proxies. The Cloudflare exit IP reflects this app's network path only. Verify Claude's actual exit in the dedicated browser.

将专用浏览器设置为严格 DNS over HTTPS。企业策略或代理可能覆盖设置: Configure strict DNS over HTTPS in the dedicated browser. Enterprise policies or proxies may override it. This does not constitute a DNS leak test.
配置文件包含强制中文语言，普通偏好无法覆盖。系统或企业策略还需在浏览器 poli: The profile forces Chinese languages, which ordinary preferences cannot override. Check system or enterprise policies on the browser's policy page.
同时核验 selected_languages 与 accept_languag: Check both selected_languages and accept_languages. If pages still show Chinese, confirm the dedicated window, quit completely and restart, and inspect policies or extensions.
可选新加坡（UTC+8）、UTC（UTC+0）或系统支持的自定义时区。新加坡不会: Choose Singapore (UTC+8), UTC (UTC+0) or a system-supported custom timezone. Singapore retains the UTC+8 offset. UTC displays time 8 hours earlier than Beijing time. This affects the entire system and can be restored from history.
这是本机系统偏移，不是网页实测。新加坡和上海同为 UTC+8，站点仍可能计分；可: This is the computer's system offset, not an observed browser value. Singapore and Shanghai both use UTC+8. Select UTC+0 separately in the timezone panel if needed.
Intl 区域设置与首选语言不是同一个值。请打开本地复检页并导入报告；不能凭配置: The Intl locale differs from the preferred language. Open the local check and import its report. Configuration alone cannot prove this check passed.
专用启动器设置 TZ=Asia/Singapore 与英文 locale。仅影响: The launcher sets TZ=Asia/Singapore and an English locale. Only its child processes are affected. Existing network and API configuration is inherited.
常见系统目录未发现匹配: No matches in common system directories
系统目录发现 {0} 个中文字体文件: Found {0} Chinese font files in system directories
可打开字体管理，主动选择可卸载的用户字体；系统字体与字体组件保留。此目录检查不是: Open font management to select removable user fonts. System fonts and components are kept. This directory check is not a complete installed font list and does not prove web font checks passed.
DNT 只是隐私偏好，不保证网站停止跟踪，也不关闭 Claude Code 遥测: DNT expresses a preference. It does not guarantee that sites stop tracking or disable Claude Code telemetry. Verify GPC support in the browser.
GPU 型号与图形后端是设备特征，不替换渲染器字符串。: GPU models and graphics backends are device characteristics. Renderer strings are not replaced.
网页尺寸与像素比例可能受显示缩放和浏览器缩放影响。: Display scaling and browser zoom may affect web dimensions and pixel ratio.
4g 是连接质量估计等级，并不证明使用了蜂窝网络。: 4g is an estimated connection quality class. It does not prove cellular network use.
网页插件常是内置 PDF 查看器；逻辑处理器提示不是物理核心数。: Web plugins are often built-in PDF viewers. Logical processor hints are not physical core counts.
UA 推断与 Emoji 渲染需分开确认: Verify UA inference and emoji rendering separately
截图的 Microsoft style 来自 UA 中的 Windows 平台信: Microsoft style in the screenshot comes from the UA's Windows platform signal, not an emoji pixel test. Platform characteristics do not prove the user's country. The UA and system fonts are kept.
仅限制此专用 Firefox 可用的系统字体，保留电脑字体和日常浏览器。部分中文: Restrict only system fonts available in this dedicated Firefox profile. Computer fonts and everyday browsers are kept. Chinese rendering may change; web fonts remain available. Restart and verify in the browser. Restore from history if needed.
关闭此专用 Firefox 的 WebRTC，网页音视频通话可能不可用，可从记录: Disable WebRTC in this dedicated Firefox profile. Web audio/video calls may be unavailable. Restore from history if needed.
Firefox 使用 GPC 表达不出售或分享数据的偏好。新版本可能不提供 DN: Firefox uses GPC to express a preference not to sell or share data. New versions may not provide DNT. Verify in the browser.
读取专用 Firefox 的启动偏好与运行偏好；配置写入不等于实际网页检测通过。: Read the dedicated Firefox profile's startup and runtime preferences. Written settings do not prove observed web checks passed.
Claude 同域名出口未取得，需浏览器复检: Claude hostname exit IP unavailable. Verify in browser.
本机 TCP HTTPS 页面检查（含 VPN / TUN，不读取浏览器代理）；: Local TCP HTTPS page checks include VPN / TUN routing but do not read browser proxies. Region-unavailable pages and verification challenges are not counted as healthy. The general Cloudflare exit may differ from Claude's route. Verify HTTP/3 (QUIC) routing and account access in the browser.
HTTP {0} · 页面读取失败，需浏览器复检: HTTP {0} · Page read failed. Verify in browser.
HTTP {0} · 页面可达，账号可用性待复检: HTTP {0} · Page reachable. Verify account access separately.
仅处理当前用户目录中识别到的中文字体，影响该用户的所有应用。系统字体、所有用户字: Only recognized Chinese fonts in the current user's directories are processed. This affects all apps for that user. System fonts, fonts installed for all users and components are kept. Web width checks can be wrong. Quit the browser completely after removal. Windows font caches may require sign-out or restart.
没有找到此浏览器，请先安装所选的 Chrome、Microsoft Edge 或: Browser not found. Install the selected Chrome, Microsoft Edge or Firefox first.
当前系统不在支持范围内: This operating system is not supported
目标时区不在系统支持的清单中，请搜索并选择有效时区: Target timezone is not in the system-supported list. Search and select a valid timezone.
无法读取系统 UTC 偏移: Could not read the system UTC offset
专用浏览器仍在运行。请保存未完成的输入，并从该专用窗口的浏览器菜单选择“退出”；: The dedicated browser is still running. Save unfinished input and choose Quit from its browser menu. Closing tabs alone may leave background processes running. Your everyday browser can stay open.
专用浏览器仍被锁定。请关闭窗口；若已退出，请重启浏览器后正常退出再重试。: The dedicated browser is still locked. Close its windows. If it already quit, restart it and quit normally before retrying.
请选择已存在的绝对工作目录，例如 D:\\Projects 或 /Users/n: Choose an existing absolute working directory, such as D:\Projects or /Users/name/Projects.
未找到 {0}，请先安装后点击重新检测。: Could not find {0}. Install it, then click Check again.
这个终端启动器已被修改，未覆盖它。请移走自定义文件后重试。: This terminal launcher was customized and was not overwritten. Move the custom file before retrying.
无法打开 Terminal，请检查 macOS 自动化权限。: Could not open Terminal. Check macOS automation permissions.
目前终端启动支持 Windows 和 macOS。: Terminal launch currently supports Windows and macOS.
配置文件超出大小限制: Configuration file exceeds the size limit
配置文件不是有效的 JSON，请先检查文件；未覆盖原文件。: The configuration file is not valid JSON. Check it first. The original was not overwritten.
修复记录损坏，请保留 history.json 并检查后重试。: Repair history is damaged. Keep history.json and inspect it before retrying.
此项目需要手动处理，无法自动修复: This item requires manual action and cannot be repaired automatically
此设置已被浏览器或其他程序修改，本次未覆盖。请先检查设置。: This setting was changed by the browser or another program. It was not overwritten. Check it first.
配置写入后未通过验证；可从记录恢复: Verification failed after writing the configuration. Restore from history if needed.
字体限制仅适用于专用 Firefox，需要明确勾选确认；电脑字体不会删除。: Font restrictions apply only to dedicated Firefox and require explicit confirmation. Computer fonts are not deleted.
已备份原值，等待写入: Original values backed up. Waiting to apply.
设置已写入并验证；请启动专用环境后复检: Settings written and verified. Launch the dedicated environment to check the actual result.
当前已是目标设置，无需修改: Already using the target setting. No changes needed.
已取消管理员授权，系统时区未确认修改。可稍后重试或在系统设置中手动调整。: Administrator authorization canceled. The system timezone change was not confirmed. Retry later or change it manually in system settings.
系统时区修改后未通过验证。自动时区或组织策略可能覆盖设置，请到系统设置检查。: The system timezone change failed verification. Automatic timezone settings or organization policies may override it. Check system settings.
系统时区 {0} · 实际偏移 {1}。请完全退出专用浏览器，再重新打开复检。: System timezone {0} · Actual offset {1}. Quit the dedicated browser completely, then reopen it to verify.
专用浏览器已退出，可以继续修复。: The dedicated browser has quit. Repairs can continue.
请先安装 Claude Code，再准备专用启动器: Install Claude Code before preparing its dedicated launcher
配置文件包含强制中文语言，无法用普通偏好覆盖；未修改强制语言字段。: Forced Chinese languages cannot be overridden by ordinary preferences. The forced language fields were kept.
设置浏览器语言与定位权限。时区跟随电脑，地理位置由浏览器处理。: Set browser language and location permissions. Timezone follows the computer; location is handled by the browser.
允许定位时，网站可使用浏览器提供的实际位置。: When location is allowed, websites can use the actual location provided by the browser.
按代理出口国家匹配常用语言；启动时会在浏览器内再次确认。按域名分流时，检测服务与: Match common languages to the proxy exit country; the browser checks again at launch. With domain-based routing, the lookup service and destination website may use different exits.
使用 Firefox 原生统一保护，覆盖时区、Canvas、屏幕及部分硬件信号。: Use Firefox built-in protection for timezone, Canvas, screen and some hardware signals. Incompatible with IP-matched language; available with a custom language.
单独检查实际时间，不用时区判断准确性: Check absolute time separately from timezone
电脑时间与 HTTPS 参考偏差在 2 分钟内: Computer clock is within 2 minutes of the HTTPS reference
电脑时间与 HTTPS 参考相差约 {0} 秒: Computer clock differs from the HTTPS reference by approximately {0} seconds
未取得可靠的 HTTPS 时间参考。时区和 UTC 偏移正常不代表电脑时间准确；: No reliable HTTPS time reference was obtained. A valid timezone and UTC offset do not confirm clock accuracy. Enable automatic time and sync in system Date & Time settings.
参考为 Cloudflare HTTPS 响应的服务端时间，包含网络延迟容差，不: The reference is the server timestamp in a Cloudflare HTTPS response, with a network delay tolerance. It does not replace system clock synchronization. For Incorrect device time, enable automatic time and sync now; changing timezone does not sync the clock.
时间与出口检测失败，请检查网络、代理以及系统日期与时间: Time and exit lookup failed. Check the network, proxy and system Date & Time settings.
出口检测结果过大: Exit lookup response is too large
出口检测结果格式无效: Exit lookup response has an invalid format
演示模式不进行实际时间校验。时区正常不代表电脑时间准确。: Demo mode does not check the actual clock. A valid timezone does not confirm clock accuracy.
若网页验证反复失败，请改为自定义语言后重启副本。: If website verification keeps failing, switch to a custom language and restart the profile.
时区只影响本地时间显示，不会校准电脑时钟。若网页提示 Incorrect dev: Timezone changes only affect local time display; they do not sync the clock. For Incorrect device time, enable automatic time and sync in system Date & Time settings, then restart the profile and check again.
打开系统日期与时间，启用自动设置时间并立即同步，再重新检测。: Open system Date & Time settings, enable automatic time and sync now, then check again.
修改时区只影响本地时间显示，不会校准电脑时钟；不要根据代理地区手动增减电脑时间。: Timezone changes only affect local time display. They do not sync the clock. Do not manually add or subtract hours based on the proxy location.
此检测使用 HTTPS 服务端时间，容许网络延迟和 2 分钟偏差。检测失败表示尚: This check uses a server timestamp over HTTPS and tolerates network delays and a 2-minute difference. A failed check means accuracy is unconfirmed.
若时间同步后网页仍提示 Incorrect device time，请改用自定义: If Incorrect device time persists after syncing, use a custom browser language, disable strict fingerprint protection and restart the profile. Check the proxy connection and browser verification separately.
读取系统时区标识。修改时区只改变本地时间显示，不会校准电脑时钟；时间准确性请查看: Reads the system timezone identifier. Changing timezone affects local time display but does not sync the clock. See the separate system clock check for accuracy. Changes affect all applications and can be restored from history.
这是本机系统时区对应的 UTC 偏移。UTC+8 本身不是异常，也不能判断时钟是: This is the UTC offset for the computer's timezone. UTC+8 is not an error and does not determine clock accuracy; see the system clock check.
网页 Date.getTimezoneOffset() 的采集结果，仅作信息展示: Observed Date.getTimezoneOffset() value, shown for information only. UTC+8 is not an error and does not mean the clock is inaccurate.
UTC 偏移由所选时区和夏令时规则决定，仅作信息展示，没有单独的修复设置。: The UTC offset follows the selected timezone and daylight saving rules. It is informational and has no separate repair setting.
新加坡和上海同为 UTC+8，这是正常时区偏移，不需要为了消除提示改为 UTC。: Singapore and Shanghai both use UTC+8. This is a normal offset; there is no need to switch to UTC to clear a warning.
时间是否准确请查看系统时钟检测；修改时区不会校准电脑时间。: See the system clock check for time accuracy. Changing the timezone does not synchronize the clock.
